Tools / 02

Check a box's inner space

Enter item size, per-side cushioning space and box inner size. Rotate only items whose orientation may be changed.

Result

All calculations run in your browser. Inputs are not sent to a Vijeron server.

Formula & limits

Required side = item side + 2 × per-side clearance. Every required side must be ≤ its matching inner box side; rotation tests six right-angle orientations.

Numeric fit does not prove safe packing. Irregular shape, real cushioning, strength and orientation rules require a physical trial.

Measured Packaging

Geometry planning tools, not a rate quote, packaging certification or delivery guarantee.
